scope: Normally launched installed app; actual native status-menu tracking and Quit, not an AXPress on a closed status item.
method: HID click opened the real native status menu; AXPress invoked its own inklow.menu.quit item.
visibility_limit: Thaw hid the status item in its collapsed group. Temporarily expanding the group exposed the registered item; no global hider preferences were changed. Persistent always-visible placement still needs an unlocked desktop.
privacy: No raw menu screenshot published; it contained the active user domain.
